verdict.rationale: Employee referrals are a fair axis for an all-in-one ATS/CRM like Ashby, but the evidence pack never documents an employee-facing flow for submitting a referral, tracking its status, or seeing where it stands. The only mention is that 'referrals' are among the record types the MCP server can search. That shows referral data exists, not that employees have a referral workflow, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an employee, I can refer candidates through a real referral flow — submit, track status, and see where my referral stands
